fundamentals.name: Datadog, Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Datadog, Inc. operates an observability and security platform for cloud applications in the United States and internationally. The company's products comprise infrastructure and application performance monitoring, log management, observability pipelines, synthetics, real user monitoring, product analytics, continuous profiler, database monitoring, data observability, LLM observability, error tracking, network monitoring, incident response, workflow automation and App builder, event management, bits AI SRE, cloud cost management, cloud security, code security, cloud SIEM, threat management, sensitive data scanner, and CI visibility. Datadog, Inc. was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in New York, New York.

judgment.summary: High-growth company with strong revenue and earnings expansion, but trades at a very high valuation and has thin operating margins.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter beat EPS estimate by 18.3%; next earnings date is 2026-08-06.
positives: Revenue growth 32.2% YoY and earnings growth 104.0% YoY indicate strong top and bottom-line expansion.
Quarterly earnings growth of 113.4% suggests accelerating profitability.
Gross margin of 79.9% is exceptionally high.
Strong free cash flow of $936.73M TTM.
Consensus rating is strong buy with a high mean analyst target.
negatives: Trailing P/E of 652.87 and Forward P/E of 87.17 indicate a very high valuation.
Operating margin of 0.8% and profit margin of 3.7% are thin despite high gross margins.
Mean analyst target of $225.34 is below the current spot price.

news.paragraph: Datadog shares have seen recent pressure, dropping 2.5% on news of insider selling and trading down after a prior rally. While some analysts highlight robust growth potential, others question its valuation, with GF Value suggesting it may be overvalued. The stock is experiencing significant investor interest and scrutiny following recent price movements.
